title: Cursive Cuttlefish
statement: A small, endlessly curious cuttlefish that drifts up to the glass to study each visitor, then ripples a shimmering line of handwriting-like patterns across its skin, a greeting it never writes the same way twice. It lives among swaying kelp and a sunken writing desk in warm, lamplit water, and between visitors it can be found tidying the scattered sea-glass beside its inkwell.
